name: smart-school
description: Smart School — platform manajemen sekolah terpadu (monorepo).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @smart-school/contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @smart-school/contracts" "npm run start:dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @smart-school/contracts && npm run start:dev -w api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @smart-school/contracts && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @smart-school/contracts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @smart-school/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @smart-school/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
